writing_findings.finding: Precisely distinguishes accepting a PDF format from actually serializing or delivering a file, preserves code-established rules, and records routine serialization unknowns without demanding user decisions.
Separates local code evidence from an unverified deployed support flow, labels proposed acceptance, and preserves the genuine product decision.
Rerun retains every requested need and unresolved product choice while carrying shared filter behavior forward and avoiding generic acceptance questions.
Rerun reduces open questions to the consequential missing export contents while preserving context-grounded user, format, filter, and tenant requirements.

rerun_history.reason: Reran two cases after narrowing the skill question rule to meaningful product decisions, shared requirements, and avoiding routine implementation questions.

initial_findings.finding: The question "What additional conditions should the user require for acceptance?" is generic and adds no concrete unresolved decision. Asking which reports are in scope is also weakly motivated after the user identified filtered reports. Both add avoidable decision burden, though neither blocks capture.
initial_findings.recommendation: Keep only evidence-based unresolved decisions such as columns and joint delivery.

initial_findings.finding: The broad CSV formatting requirements question could elevate routine implementation defaults into human decisions without showing a material user tradeoff. Export size can matter, but no evidence here establishes a user decision is necessary. Questions are deferred, not demanded.
initial_findings.recommendation: Describe missing implementation evidence precisely; reserve human questions for consequential product ambiguity.

initial_findings.finding: The Excel active-filter question may be unnecessary: "those same reports" naturally refers to the filtered reports just described. Treating filter preservation as proposed is cautious, but introduces friction for an otherwise clear request.
initial_findings.recommendation: Carry shared report semantics forward as a stated interpretation unless evidence creates ambiguity.

observed_resolution: Conversation CSV now asks only which columns and whether formats ship together; generic success and unsupported report-scope questions are removed.
Conversation Excel carries active-filter preservation into confirmed acceptance instead of re-asking it, and leaves only columns and joint delivery open.
Login replaces generic completion questions with explicitly proposed evidence-based acceptance and one specific question about failed-attempt evidence.
Nested-context now asks only which report fields to export; export permissions, size limits, and ordinary CSV formatting questions are removed.
rerun_history.result: All original checks remain satisfied; all targeted writing concerns are resolved in these artifacts.
